title: Cyan's Dumdums
description: A silly mod that adds random features every tuesday!
body:
# Cyan’s Dumdums

Welcome to **Cyan’s Dumdums**, a mod that doesn’t take itself seriously at all.
It’s built to be **weird, funny, and chaotic**, giving you and your friends random features that range from useful… to completely ridiculous.

If you’ve ever wanted Minecraft to feel like a fever dream, this is the mod for you.

## 🎉 Current Features
### 💎 Random Gear & Resources

- **Ruby Ore, Tools & Armor** – a shiny new set of gear for dum-dum adventurers.

### 🧪 Chaotic Potions

- **God Potion** – drink it and become absurdly powerful (don’t question the side effects).

### 🎵 Meme & Fun Stuff

- **“Minecrafting” Music Disc** – an epic track for your adventures.

- **Meme Painting** – hang it on your wall to remind everyone this mod makes no sense.

## 😂 Why Play Cyan’s Dumdums?

Because not every mod needs to be serious.
Cyan’s Dumdums is about **laughs, randomness, and having a good time** with friends. Whether you’re overpowered with the God Potion or jamming to the Minecrafting disc, this mod keeps things silly.

## 🛠 Planned Features (a.k.a. More Dumdum Content)

- Extra joke items and overpowered gear.

- More meme paintings and funny blocks.

- Surprises that don’t make sense (on purpose).

## ⚡ Installation ##
1. Download the latest Cyan’s Dumdums build.

2. Install **Fabric/Forge** (depending on release type).

3. Drop the .jar into your **mods** folder.

4. Launch Minecraft and enjoy the chaos.
   
Any ideas? Check my channel [here.](https://www.youtube.com/@cyang476/featured)

_Updates will come whenever the dumdum dev remembers to update. If not… oops._
